texts.label: R120, Madrid 13 Oct 1767
texts.summary: The nuncio Lucini reports that the Marqués de Grimaldi asked, in the king's name, for renewal without time limit, and extension to the secular clergy, of the faculty Pallavicini had granted on 1 July 1766 to make churchmen give evidence before lay judges in cases of lèse-majesté; he offers a time-limited proroga with his predecessor's cautions and asks for instructions. The ciphered last sentence gives his view of the motive: putting down the internal disturbances of the monarchy and the risings in various places (after the 1766 riots and the Jesuit expulsion of April 1767).
